Félpálcás téglalap (03 §3.1 A)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
hdc – half double crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
half double crochet (hdc)

Félpálcás téglalap
Foundation: ch 17.
Row 1: Starting in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch count as 1 hdc), 14 hdc (15 sts). Turn.
Rows 2–21: ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc), 14 hdc (15 sts). Turn.
Row 22: ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc), 14 hdc (15 sts). Fasten off.
